name: Coach or consultant
description: For coaches and consultants who sell expertise through calls, programs or retainers. Leans on client proof, frameworks and answering real buyer questions.
forWho: Business, career, health and executive coaches
Service businesses where the owner is the expertise (coaching, financial planning, fitness)

evidence.claim: Trust content (questions answered, process shown) does more for a high-ticket sale than reach content.
evidence.note: Consistent with how considered purchases work; measure it on your own data with the learn module before leaning harder.

evidence.claim: Comment-a-keyword calls to action out-convert 'link in bio' on Instagram.
evidence.note: Widely reported by practitioners; depends on a working comment-to-DM automation.

evidence.claim: Posting more short videos does not reduce reach per post on Instagram.
evidence.note: Stated publicly by the platform. Watch your own views per post if volume goes up.
